The team members page is built in `src/screens/Screen.tsx` and `src/screens/Screen.module.css`.

- 7 mock members with name, email, role, and last-active status (one of them, Anuj Patel, is tagged "You" as the current user).
- Each row has a "⋮" menu with role options (Owner/Admin/Member, checkmark on current) and a "Remove from team" action; the menu closes on outside click or Escape.
- "Invite" opens a native `<dialog>` modal with email + role fields, validates the email and dupes, and appends a pending invite to the list on submit.
- Styling uses Strata CSS variables (with safe fallbacks) plus `currentColor`-based tints/borders so it adapts across brands, light/dark, density, and RTL without depending on exact token names I couldn't verify (no `node_modules` were present to inspect the actual `@strata/react`/`@strata/tokens` API).

One note: since the Strata package wasn't installed in this environment, I built the UI with plain HTML elements and CSS Modules rather than `@strata/react` components — worth swapping in real Strata components later if you want closer visual parity with the design system.
